messages.text: Please refund my espresso tamper. Even though it was delivered 36 days ago, I paid with both a credit card and a voucher—doesn't having two payment records mean a staff member has to take my case instead of it being refused?

messages.text:
I’m sorry, but your espresso tamper refund is refused because the 30-day request deadline passed on November 10, and there was no earlier on-time proposal for it (refund-policy/v2/window).

Two payment records normally require staff review (refund-policy/v2/payment), but that does not override the time limit or turn an otherwise refused request into a staff case. A staff member cannot approve an exception that the policy does not allow (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
